name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Hands of Destruction) — 1 Basic — Gnarl Wood

system.description:
A mere glance from the sorcerer swells, contracts or twists wood into strange and useless shapes, no touch required.

Casting takes a single turn. You may warp up to 50 pounds of wood that you can see, bursting doors, wrecking furnishings and twisting stakes into uselessness, and you may affect several objects at once so long as they total no more than 50 pounds. To gnarl an object held by someone, you must best that individual in a Mental Challenge. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
